physicalNotes: Radius 0.669 +/- 0.056 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1782.02 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 465,423 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 4336 +/- 121 K from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1782.02 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
